title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly
disclaimer: Not financial advice · do your own due diligence

sector_scoreboard.story: AMD moved from Core-adjacent to Watch: priced near its ~$565 consensus target and tied to OpenAI's 6GW GPU deal after the FT cut OpenAI's run-rate to ~$50B (Bloomberg: still ~$70B expected by year-end). Nvidia set a $243 record Oct 6 then fell ~3%, while TSMC posted record September sales.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: The question is who funds the customers: OpenAI's pending $30B+ round now sits at ~28x the lower revenue figure, and TSMC's Oct 15 print is the next read-through for the whole stack.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Teradyne slipped to ~$403 (from ~$449) and stays on Watch; Symbotic's $22.5B backlog was highlighted, Nvidia reportedly weighs ~$1B more into Figure AI, and Tesla fell 1.4% as Barron's questioned Optimus.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Compute and reshoring suppliers (Nvidia, Rockwell, MP) have evidence behind them; humanoid timelines still outrun it.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. BAE fell >5% on UK spending-target delay fears, drones sold off despite Neros's ~$100M order, Berenberg cut Rheinmetall to Hold, and Palantir hit a record on Barclays and Goldman upgrades.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Demand is intact (Europe heading to 3.5% of GDP) but the continuing resolution to Dec 11 freezes 150+ new starts including Golden Dome.

sector_scoreboard.story: DATA NOT REFRESHED THIS WEEK: the nuclear research task did not update (last data Sep 28). Prior read: hyperscaler money goes to existing reactors and uprates, not pre-revenue SMRs.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Treat as stale until the sector task is rerun; no stance data validated.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. MP Materials sits at $46.15 with 22% short interest after a Morgan Stanley target cut to $66; REMX hit a one-year low; the US-China truce now runs to Jan 10, 2027, and a Chilean copper strike began Oct 7.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Rare-earth names price a thaw while China's April 2025 licensing stays in force; copper (~$14.6K/t) is near record on supply disruption.

sector_scoreboard.story: DATA NOT REFRESHED THIS WEEK: the space research task did not update (last data Sep 28). Prior read: SpaceX lockup unlocks and RKLB >40x revenue are the pressure points.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Treat as stale until the sector task is rerun; no stance data validated.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Tesla's 13.7 GWh Q3 deployment missed the ~15.9 GWh Street estimate by ~14%; Fluence (~$7.45) is under class-action and guidance-cut pressure and Eos hit a new low near $2.51, while GE Vernova closed ~$999.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Oct 21 is the test: Tesla's energy margin and GE Vernova's backlog against a $200B early-2027 target.

sector_scoreboard.story: Schrodinger moved to Watch: at $27.28 it is ~27% above the $21.43 average target with no approved drug. Tempus expanded the Moderna/Merck cancer-vaccine collaboration, Illumina closed $278 (~52x earnings) and Recursion jumped 10% to $4.36.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Lilly (Oct 29) and Illumina (Oct 29) earnings are the next checks; several small caps carry heavy short interest.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. DARPA moved IonQ, IBM, Atom Computing and Diraq into QBI Stage C and Nvidia pledged $1B to US science, yet a bond rout sent IonQ -8.9%, Rigetti -8.0%, D-Wave -7.6% and Quantinuum -10.4% to a new low.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Sector revenue is ~$1.5B against $4.7-10.9B pure-play market caps; price-to-sales runs 64-473x.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Two cuts, no upgrades: AMD and Schrodinger to Watch
cross_cutting_themes.description: Of seven sectors with fresh data, only AMD (AI) and Schrodinger (Biotech) moved, both down to Watch on price running ahead of evidence. The pattern from recent weeks holds: good businesses, wrong prices.

cross_cutting_themes.title: OpenAI's revenue reset keeps circular-financing worries alive
cross_cutting_themes.description: The FT's ~$50B OpenAI run-rate hit AI chips and AMD; Bloomberg says ~$70B is still expected by year-end. Anthropic's leaked S-1 shows $518B of mostly non-cancellable compute commitments.

cross_cutting_themes.title: 10-year near 5.23% is a 24-year high
cross_cutting_themes.description: Long yields are the gravity on quantum, SMR, humanoid and biotech names; quantum fell 8-10% in a day on the bond rout despite DARPA good news.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Contracts and milestones are not lifting prices
cross_cutting_themes.description: Neros's order, DARPA Stage C and Tesla's storage volumes all failed to hold share prices; MP, Eos and Fluence sit near lows.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The calendar is the catalyst
cross_cutting_themes.description: CPI (Oct 14), TSMC (Oct 15), Tesla and GE Vernova (Oct 21), Fed (Oct 27-28), the Dec 11 CR and the Jan 10 rare-earth truce deadline set the next legs.

news_of_the_week.title: FT: OpenAI annualized revenue ~$50B, not ~$70B
news_of_the_week.description: A definitional gap rather than lost sales, but Nasdaq fell 1.3% and SOXX 3.5%; Bloomberg followed that ~$70B is still expected by year-end.

news_of_the_week.title: DARPA moves IonQ, IBM, Atom Computing and Diraq to QBI Stage C
news_of_the_week.description: IonQ's deal is worth up to $300M through 2029; shares still sold off with the bond market.

news_of_the_week.title: 10-year Treasury touches ~5.37%, a 24-year high
news_of_the_week.description: It eased to ~5.23% by week end; the S&P 500 set an all-time closing high Oct 6 and is up 13%+ YTD.

news_of_the_week.title: Tesla deploys 13.7 GWh in Q3, ~14% below Street
news_of_the_week.description: Second-best quarter ever, but the margin print on Oct 21 is the real test.

news_of_the_week.title: Strike begins at Antofagasta's Centinela copper mine
news_of_the_week.description: Copper sits ~2% under its record; MP Materials short interest is 22% of float.

week_ahead.title: Big-bank earnings
week_ahead.description: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and Wells Fargo report; credit quality and AI-linked lending commentary matter.

week_ahead.title: September CPI
week_ahead.description: Consensus ~3.6% headline, ~2.5% core; drives the long-yield pressure on speculative names.

week_ahead.title: TSMC earnings
week_ahead.description: The key read-through for AI compute demand, capex (~$60-64B plan) and 2027 guidance.

week_ahead.title: Tesla Q3 and GE Vernova Q3
week_ahead.description: Tesla energy margin and GEV backlog against the $200B target (GEV date unconfirmed).

week_ahead.title: FOMC meeting
week_ahead.description: Traders have trimmed odds of another hike.

week_ahead.title: Lilly and Illumina Q3
week_ahead.description: Test of the AI-biotech compute-layer thesis.
